candidates.name: op-income-history-industry-rank
candidates.thesis: Companies whose operating income is strong relative to their own history may be undergoing persistent operating improvement.

candidates.name: op-margin-revenue-ratio
candidates.thesis: Operating income scaled by revenue approximates operating margin and should be compared within industry.

candidates.name: op-income-change-zscore
candidates.thesis: Sustained operating-income improvement can lag in prices when accounting updates arrive slowly.

candidates.name: op-income-current-assets-ratio
candidates.thesis: Operating income scaled by current assets proxies operating efficiency on working capital.

candidates.name: fair-liability-history-negative
candidates.thesis: Rising level-1 fair-value liabilities can indicate balance-sheet pressure or future cash burden.

candidates.name: fair-liability-assets-ratio-negative
candidates.thesis: Fair-value liabilities scaled by current assets identify firms with heavier balance-sheet pressure.

candidates.name: fair-liability-zscore-negative
candidates.thesis: A standardized fair-value-liability shock should be negative if it marks financial stress.

candidates.name: fair-liability-zscore-positive-control
candidates.thesis: Sign control for fair-value liabilities; keep only if the positive sign is empirically dominant.

candidates.name: fcf-max-slow-rank-63
candidates.thesis: High analyst maximum FCF estimates may proxy optimistic cash-generation expectations.

candidates.name: fcf-max-slow-rank-126
candidates.thesis: Slower FCF-estimate smoothing tests whether the idea survives lower turnover.

candidates.name: fcfps-guidance-level
candidates.thesis: Strong annual FCF per share guidance can indicate future cash-flow strength.

candidates.name: fcfps-guidance-change
candidates.thesis: An upward change in FCFPS guidance should matter more than a high stale level.

candidates.name: fcf-actual-vs-low-estimate
candidates.thesis: Actual FCF exceeding low-side estimates can identify downside-risk relief or positive cash-flow surprise.

candidates.name: fcf-actual-slow-rank
candidates.thesis: Sustained actual FCF strength can be slower and less parameter-sensitive than 5-day zscores.

candidates.name: fcf-low-estimate-slow-rank
candidates.thesis: High low-side FCF estimates may proxy reduced downside uncertainty in cash generation.

candidates.name: current-assets-revenue-ratio
candidates.thesis: Current assets relative to revenue may proxy working-capital intensity; sign is uncertain and needs controls.

candidates.name: current-assets-revenue-ratio-negative-control
candidates.thesis: Negative sign control: excessive current-asset intensity can indicate inefficient working capital or inventory/receivables buildup.
